sentences.en: I think I will take a detour to return home.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我绕个路回家吧。

sentences.en: He took a detour to avoid the heavy traffic.
sentences.zh: 他绕了个路以避开拥堵的交通。

sentences.en: What percentage of all taxi drivers make unscrupulous detours, do you think?
sentences.zh: 你认为所有出租车司机中有多少比例会故意绕远路？
